title: AI融资潮涌来：市场胃口够吗，科技公司CDS现裂痕
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: I'll get to diversity in a second, but I really want to get your take on just what we're seeing across these markets here right now at a time of so much disruption when it comes
segments.zh: 我稍后会谈到多元化，但我真的很想听听您对当前这些市场的看法，尤其是在如此多颠覆性变化的时期，当涉及到

segments.en: to AI, the earnings picture hasn't really done well either when it comes to really getting that ROI when it comes to AI.
segments.zh: 人工智能时，盈利情况也并未真正做好，尤其是在真正获得人工智能**回报方面。

segments.en: You've been sounding alarm for some time now about this AI boom.
segments.zh: 您一段时间以来一直在对人工智能热潮发出警告。

segments.en: How concerned are you of that we're in this AI bubble right now?
segments.zh: 您有多担心我们现在正处于人工智能泡沫中？

segments.en: Well, I think the technology is absolutely real and I think it's going to be game changing for many industries and many companies.
segments.zh: 嗯，我认为这项技术绝对是真实的，我认为它将改变许多行业和许多公司的游戏规则。

segments.en: I do think there's a bit of a disconnect between the expectations of the AI companies themselves and maybe the rate at which enterprises can adopt it.
segments.zh: 我确实认为人工智能公司自身的期望与企业采用它的速度之间有点脱节。

segments.en: And I think we're seeing a little bit of that in market reactions now that maybe it's not happening quite as fast as everyone thought or the ROI is not quite clear.
segments.zh: 我认为我们现在在市场反应中看到了一点，也许它并没有大家想象的那么快发生，或者**回报并不那么清晰。

segments.en: And I do think markets are getting very concerned about the scale of the capital raising involved, whether there's enough appetite in both equity and fixed income for all the issuance that's
segments.zh: 我确实认为市场非常担心所涉及的融资规模，以及权益资产和固定收益市场是否有足够的需求来消化所有即将发行的

segments.en: coming to fund it. I mean, you have a question about these sort of big circular deals, I mean, are they ultimately going to be on the balance sheets in terms of receivables or liability?
segments.zh: 为资助它而发行的。我的意思是，您对这些大型循环交易有疑问，它们最终会作为应收款还是负债出现在资产负债表上？

segments.en: We're starting to see that cracks in some of the CDS spreads of some of these tech companies.
segments.zh: 我们开始看到一些科技公司的CDS利差出现裂痕。

segments.en: So what do you think investors are still missing when it comes to the debt picture of what these companies are really needing to handle now?
segments.zh: 那么，您认为在债务状况方面，市场参与者还忽略了什么？这些公司现在真正需要应对的是什么？

segments.en: Well, I think it's difficult to get the true picture because a lot of it is off balance sheet in other vehicles that are not consolidated.
segments.zh: 嗯，我认为很难看清真实情况，因为很多债务都在表外，存在于未合并的其他工具中。
